item.title: SFA throw out Celtic appeal on Trusty’s red card at Tynecastle
item.description: Celtic has LOST their appeal against the red card shown to Auston Trusty at Tynecastle on Sunday afternoon. The Champions appealed the decision yesterday afternoon and a fast-track hearing was set for today but is has been UNSUCCESSFUL and Trusty will now sit out the game against Falkirk this week as he serves his suspension. item.title: Celtic linked with £6m move for prolific Bodø/Glimt striker
